scope: formal and diagnostic mark the executed model step against the bracketed original input; per-field comparisons are recorded separately. Original UUIDs do not imply native UUIDs are present on the model side.

actual_shuffle.definition: original old discard UUID appears in later draw pile within same combat; public comparison tests resulting hand and pile counts, not native hidden order

simultaneous_multi_enemy_damage.denominator: Comparisons of bridged combat HP before/after in multi-live-enemy rooms; separate attacks do not establish AoE.

ink_bottle.definition: 9-to-0 InkBottle transitions with newly drawn card UUIDs checked against previous draw/discard. Some card plays have other draws; no unique attribution is inferred for those copies.

snake_ring.limits: Original has Ring of the Snake at room entry and displays first hands. This does not isolate a causal counterfactual without the relic.
